# Healthcare Standards

This folder contains the organizations responsible for driving clinical quality development and publishing national quality reports within the Danish healthcare system. It specifically covers the technical and administrative bodies that prepare the core analyses for the national ADHD database, evaluating treatment pathways, measuring quality indicators, and identifying systemic barriers to care across child, youth, and adult psychiatry.

## Pages

- [[rkkp|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] — The technical and administrative body that managed the ADHD database's analytical output and published its 2023 annual report, tracking systemic challenges in child and adolescent psychiatry.
- [[sundhedsvaesnets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] — The institute responsible for preparing the core analyses and publishing the 2024 annual report for the ADHD database, marking the first complete measurement of ADHD treatment quality across all age groups and sectors in Denmark.
